presets.name: YouTube Shorts Explainer
presets.purpose: Quick, high-retention explainer videos for YouTube Shorts
productionRules: Keep pacing fast with cuts under 3 seconds
End with a call-to-action to subscribe

presets.name: Cinematic Story Narrative
presets.purpose: Emotionally engaging story-driven videos with a cinematic look
productionRules: Use slow, deliberate pacing with wide establishing shots
Layer ambient background music under narration
Avoid on-screen text unless essential to the story

presets.name: Product Review Vlog
presets.purpose: Casual, trustworthy product review and comparison videos
productionRules: Show the product from multiple angles before narration begins
Include a pros/cons summary near the end
Disclose that the review is AI-generated
